acceptance_gaps: M2: explicit same-series supersession/clock transitions and complete CSF+SOC2 assign/reject-replace/verify-expire-refresh browser journey on top of both storage backends.

M3: two live server instances on PostgreSQL; start A/cancel B; membership removal with open stream; IdP replacement A used by B; client and relay gaps; no post-cancel proposals or post-revocation payloads.
M3: fabricated citations, edited/forged automated-check or attestation provenance, weak crosswalk confidence and two targets with opposite outcomes.

M4: one offline-verifiable download with actual artifacts and no missing refs; deterministic unchanged state; tampered bytes/checkpoint mismatches detected; referenced artifacts restored from backup fixture.
limitations: Read-only source inventory at baseline b34cf1fe846920c98aa71df3121712284880dc1a; no tests, services, database access or runtime verification were performed.
Existing test names demonstrate checked-in coverage only and are not represented as current passes.

Negative findings are bounded to inspected application/core/agent source, relevant test files, scripts and file searches; historical deployment artifacts were not treated as implemented source capabilities.
No broad internet research or official-schema validation was performed; official OSCAL validity remains unverified.
The root task may concurrently modify application files after this baseline inventory; reconcile findings against subsequent patches.
Deferred SAML/SCIM, framework expansion, broad providers and 3D additions are excluded. The GitHub API connector remains a separate optional extension after the M3 gate.
